description: Honeycomb addons for Simple Kuma. Kuma fetches this file as JSON only and never executes PHP from this repo.

addons.name: Taboola Cost API
addons.summary: Pull Taboola Backstage campaign spend into Kuma via Honeycomb (client credentials + campaign bindings).

addons.name: Whop Ads
addons.summary: Whop Ads: send conversions via Events API and sync ad spend from Ad Reports into Kuma stats.

addons.name: Ringba
addons.summary: Pay-per-call helper: optional Ringba API campaign pickers, LP scripts with click_id tagging, and pixels into Kuma postbacks.

addons.name: Kuma Deep Funnels
addons.summary: Multi-level landing page funnels inside one campaign (up to 5 levels × 5 LPs). Opaque link keys + Link code helper. Full path tracking and Funnel stats tab.
